sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:150076
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 34103 of 2024

Applicant :- Amar Singh @ Pilli
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Goyal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Ashish Goyal, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Jhamman Ram, learned AGA-I for the State.
3. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 598 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station Tajganj, District Agra during pendency of the trial.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant has been made accused in the present matter along with five others and as per allegation applicant sold the some portion of the property earlier to the informant and subsequently in the year 2018 he sold the same property to co-accused Rajni Devi but entire allegation leveled against the applicant is totally false and actually applicant sold the separate portion of the property to the informant and Rajni Devi.

He further submits that even the sale deed was executed by the applicant to Rajni Devi in the year 2018 and FIR of the Amar Singh @ Pilli vs State Of U.P. on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16300401/
1 present case was lodged in the year 2023 i.e. after five years.

entities.text: Amar Singh @ Pilli vs State Of U.P. on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that even present dispute attracts civil liability.

5. He further submits that apart from the present case applicant is however having criminal history of seven other cases including two cases of electricity Act but his criminal history has been explained in the instant bail application.
6. He further submits that and all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 19.06.2024.
7. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. However, it reflects that apart from the present case applicant is having criminal history of seven other cases but as far as allegation leveled against the applicant in the present case is concerned, this Court finds merit in the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant that present dispute attracts civil liability.
10.

Further, criminal history of the applicant has been explained in the instant bail application and all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 19.06.2024.

11. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant - Amar Singh @ Pilli be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.

2 14.

15. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
